name: Blank
description: Just a Brief and a Notes page: for anything that doesn't fit another template.
firstMove: Ask about anything unclear in the Brief, then get going, adding anything worth keeping to Notes as you go.

intake.label: What's this about?
intake.hint: In your own words; it's kept verbatim at the top of the Brief.

sections.title: What this is about
sections.collects: What this workbook is for, in the user's words. Changed only with the user's say-so.

sections.title: Where we left off
sections.collects: Where things stand: what was just done, what is next, and anything a fresh chat must know.
Anything worth keeping: results, findings, decisions, commands, links and open questions, each with enough context to make sense later.
